name: Guardian Spiked Reinforcement damages the attacker on every block (#156)
contract: #156 (Guardian, level 4): Spiked Reinforcement 653131 is applied but blocks do not deal damage back. 653131 reads 'Reinforce your shield with spikes, causing your blocks to deal ${$803131m1+$803131ppl1+$AP*0.06+$STA*0.0375} High Threat Physical damage to the attacker. Lasts 1 hour.' - no chance is stated. It is SPELL_EFFECT_ENCHANT_ITEM_TEMPORARY (shield only) with SpellItemEnchantment 1016, whose effect 0 is ITEM_ENCHANTMENT_TYPE_EQUIP_SPELL 653386: a hidden passive PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL aura for Spiked Reinforcement damage 803131 (SCHOOL_DAMAGE 5..6 +0.495/level above 8, spell_bonus_data ap_bonus 0.06, stamina*0.0375 in guardian_scaling). Server proc data: spell_proc ProcFlags 40 (taken melee auto attack and taken melee spell), HitMask 8256 (block, full block); aura_ascension_guardian_event casts 803131 at the attacker. The chance came from 653386's Spell.dbc ProcChance 30 (rev_20260908_05 wrote 30, rev_20260919_20 cleared it to defer to the DBC), so 70% of blocks dealt nothing. 30 is not an authored chance here: every hidden passive of the current shield-reinforcement family carries 30, including Weighted 653409 (aura 166) and Magic 653304 (aura 87) that never proc; the one family member with a real chance, Jagged Reinforcement 653279, states it in its tooltip ('a $653281h% chance'); and the previous Spiked Reinforcement 280405 with the same unconditional wording used aura 280406 with ProcChance 100. Expected: every blocked incoming melee attack deals one Spiked Reinforcement hit to the attacker. The harness cannot cast a spell on an item target, so the equipped enchant's aura 653386 is applied as a fixture; QA Test 100% Block 10021 (MOD_BLOCK_PERCENT +130) makes every frontal swing a block, the attackers' hit and expertise ratings remove misses, dodges and parries, and the guardians' ratings keep 803131 from missing. A control phase without 653386 proves the damage comes only from Spiked Reinforcement. Both the reported level 4 and level 80 are measured; with a 30% chance the proc/swing ratio is about 0.3, so the 0.8 lower bound fails before the fix.
